## A Body Stops At The Binary `?`

Weirdly in R, help is precedence 1 and function and loop bodies are precedence 2.
So `function() x ? y` must parse as `(function () x) ? y`.

```r
function() a ? b
function() a ? b ? c
?function() a
```
